name: OmniMapGen
description: Random maps made in the lobby, with the active mods' towns, creatures, banks and dwellings placed the way the game's own generator places them. Two layouts: Classic, an ordinary random Heroes map drawn fresh from the map size and player count, and Coldshadow's Fantasy, a template with its own fixed zones; Random picks one of them. About sixty settings on eight pages (map, zones, borders, treasure, monsters, underground, scenery, water) change the map. Adds Omni Map Gen as a mode of the Random Map window in single-player, hotseat and multiplayer lobbies: the golden arrows at the top of that window pick it, and in a multiplayer lobby the host picks the mode and its settings and the players who join see them. Needs a client with the map generator framework (DMB).
author: Renegade1993
